title: Local GraphQL backend: apricitus serve
description:
`apricitus serve --library <dir>`: a Rust server answering the same GraphQL schema as AppSync (Virtuus's `virtuus-appsync`), over the same engine and folder the Swift app uses. It serves files with Range requests, `amplify_outputs.json`, and the web app itself. The web app uses the real `aws-amplify` client against it, so it runs locally without AWS. `server.py`'s data endpoints retire.

Design: `design/storage.md` §4.

## Definition of done
- The corpus is green through the real Amplify client against `serve`.
- Playwright end-to-end tests pass.
- The UI no longer calls `/api/*`.
